summary: Implemented the decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helpers, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist covering the four required cases. All new and edited Python lines are under 120 columns. Tests were not run, black and flake8 were not run, and nothing was committed.
